description: This Java class implements a cache for resource data information in the Thingsboard platform, utilizing Caffeine cache and Spring annotations for lifecycle management.

classes.name: ResourceDataKey
classes.description: A record class used as a key in the cache, combining TenantId and TbResourceId.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the cache with specified size and TTL, setting up async loading behavior.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up the cache during bean destruction.

methods.name: getResourceDataInfoAsync
methods.description: Retrieves resource data info asynchronously from cache.

methods.name: evictResourceData
methods.description: Removes specific resource data from cache.
